environment.description: ECS Fargate service running behind an Application Load Balancer with public internet access. ALB forwards all headers including X-Forwarded-Host to the container. ElastiCache Redis cluster shared across tasks. No CloudFront distribution in front - ALB DNS is exposed directly. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to ALB.

config.redis: ElastiCache cluster, shared across all tasks
